response.sql: SELECT store_id, AVG(total_amount) AS avg_total_per_rental, AVG(payment_count) AS avg_payments_per_rental FROM (SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE p.amount >= 4.99 GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id) t GROUP BY store_id

assumptions.assumption: The '4.99 cutoff' is inclusive: qualifying payments have amount >= 4.99. The request does not say whether the cutoff is inclusive or whether it keeps amounts above or below it.
Inner joins from payment to rental to inventory drop payments with a NULL or unmatched rental_id. Store is taken from inventory.store_id.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff is exclusive: only payments with amount strictly greater than 4.99 qualify.
